source: Armagedom origin/main Web/public/assets/crow/original-crow.glb. The crow GLB carries the SAME 24-bone rat rig as the rat king (same names, same hierarchy, same rest positions to 3 decimals; the bird has no wing, leg-feather or beak bones, and shares the rat clips rat_idle, rat_walk, rat_run, rat_hit, rat_death, rat_bite, rat_bite_low). World rest position of every bone, from the GLB node JSON only (translations composed down the parents, no mesh read). Model units, before the model scale the game applies (data/bodies/crow.chain.json scale). The creature faces +z, stands on y = 0, its spine runs along z. Left is -x here.
units: glb model units (metres before the game's model scale)

bbox_model_units.source: extent of the bone points only, not the mesh (the crow mesh is wider than the rat king's in x: its wings are skinned to the chest and spine bones)
